title: N.C.R.B.,(M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1995 The District Jails in Bihar and Assam are capable of lodging a large number of prisoners. The total capacity of inmates in the district jails of these States was 9314 and 5489 respectively with an average capacity of around 321 and 250 inmates per jail.
